Subject: MicroFin pilot: temporary PO waiver request & onboarding checklist

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team is excited to run a short pilot of MicroFin’s ingestion connector with a couple of internal product teams. Before we kick off we need to sort the vendor onboarding and payment path.

Quick facts:
- Pilot scope: 1 seat for data sync + support; estimated spend ~ $2,200 over 30 days (invoiced monthly).
- Invoices: monthly; preference for net-30.
- Duration: 60-day pilot with option to expand.

Ask: Can we run this pilot on a temporary no-PO / invoice-only basis for 60 days while Finance and Procurement complete vendor setup? If so, please provide the standard intake documents (W-9, COI, vendor intake form) and an invoice sample so Marissa and Priya can evaluate risk and formally approve a short-term waiver.

I’ve looped Marissa (procurement) and Priya (finance) to confirm requirements. If you have a purchasable SOW or DocuSign link, paste it in your reply. We’d like to get this approved by end of this week to start the pilot next Monday.

Thanks,

Jordan —

Thanks for the context; welcome MicroFin. A few procurement notes and next steps from our side:

1) Required intake for any vendor: completed vendor intake form, W-9, Certificate of Insurance (general liability). For pilots we also ask for a primary billing contact and sample invoice.

2) Temporary no-PO path: we can approve a time-limited invoice-only / no-PO route for up to 60 days for low-risk pilots (under $5k total) provided Finance signs off and we capture the evidence listed above. This is a controlled exception and will be time-boxed.

3) Approvals needed:
   - Procurement (me): confirm intake documents and acceptable risk
   - Finance (Priya): confirm invoice routing and GL code setup
   - Sales/AE (Jordan): confirm estimated spend and pilot timeline

Please ask MicroFin to upload the items in (1) and include a contact for invoicing. Once we have that, Priya will confirm finance can route invoices to an invoice-only queue and I’ll issue a 60-day temporary waiver memo.

If there are any regulatory or data access concerns (e.g., PII handling, logs retention) flag those in the reply and we’ll route to Security.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
